Imax (IMAX) Holder Welch Capital Partners Has Lowered Its Holding as Share Price Declined; Noesis Capital Mangement Holding in Apple (AAPL) Lifted by $301,158
May 21, 2018 - By John Mackenzie
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22M, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $921.29B market cap company. The stock increased 0.61% or $1.13 during the last trading session, reaching $187.44. About 9.38 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Leighton Welch decreased its stake in Imax Corp (IMAX) by 18.31% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
